claims.path: Attacker deposits USDT, manipulates TARGET_POOL spot price via flash loan or large swap before deposit to skew currentTick, causing _executeMint to compute unfavorable tickLower/tickUpper, resulting in liquidity provision at manipulated price and incorrect vestingAmount calculation (based on amount1 from mint), extracting excess vesting tokens.

Attacker manipulates TARGET_POOL spot price (via flash loan) just before deposit call, altering currentTick read via slot0, leading to miscalculated tickLower/tickUpper and skewed mint amounts (amount0, amount1), enabling extraction of disproportionate liquidity or vesting amounts.
No direct attack path; function only updates internal stats based on inputs from deposit, which are derived from prior steps. No external interaction or state manipulation beyond arithmetic.
